input.quote: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
input.rationale: The renewal clause fails the fallback on two material terms: the non-renewal notice window is ninety (90) days (fallback allows no more than 60), and renewal terms are "equal in duration to the previous term," which permits automatic multi-year renewals where an Order Form specifies a multi-year initial term — walk-away territory. There is also no cap on renewal price increases anywhere in the Agreement (§ 4.1 simply refers pricing to Service Option Attachments and Order Forms). Redline moves to the preferred position: 12-month renewal terms, a 30-day opt-out window, a 60-day IBM reminder, and uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%; a 60-day window with a 5% cap is offered as the fallback.

proposal.summary: Limit auto-renewal to 12 months, shorten non-renewal notice to 30 days, add renewal reminder and cap on renewal price increases.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We limited automatic renewals to twelve months and shortened the non-renewal notice window to thirty days, since a renewal term equal to a potentially multi-year prior term plus a 90-day window makes exit impractical. We also added a 60-day renewal reminder and capped renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3% so renewal pricing is predictable; a 60-day window with uplift capped at 5% would also work for us.

ops.oldText: for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment
ops.newText: for an additional term of twelve (12) months

ops.text: IBM will notify Customer in writing of the upcoming renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term. Any increase in Charges for a renewal term will not exceed the lesser of (i) the increase in the U.S. Consumer Price Index over the preceding twelve (12) months and (ii) three percent (3%).
